fn CountOnesInOctal(a: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  ensures (result == (if (a == 0) then 0 else ((if ((a % 8) == 1) then 1 else 0) + CountOnesInOctal((a / 8)))))
  effects pure
  example (CountOnesInOctal(0) == 0)
  example (CountOnesInOctal(1) == 1)
{
  if (a == 0) then 0 else ((if ((a % 8) == 1) then 1 else 0) + CountOnesInOctal((a / 8)))
}

fn solve(a: Int) -> Int
  requires (a >= 0)
  ensures (result >= 0)
  ensures (result == CountOnesInOctal(a))
  effects pure
  example (solve(0) == 0)
